_: ぼくじょう島の英語. Server only: this file is never served to a browser. Every farm action costs one of these. `fill` = a farm sentence with a hole and four choices; `reply` = what a villager says and the one reply that fits; `brush` = a kind word for an animal; `cook` = the steps of a recipe in order; `templates` = sentences built around an item (the tokens are shuffled and put back in order).
